basic_details.job_title: AMU Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.application_mode: Online (followed by submission of hard copy)

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU

qualification.details: Senior Resident: As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU

how_to_apply: Visit the official Careers Portal of Aligarh Muslim University at careers.amuonline.ac.in.
Fill out the online application form for the respective post under advertisement number FM/39/2026.
Take a printout of the generated PDF file of the Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Affix your signature and paste a front-facing recent photograph on the designated place on the application form.

Attach self-attested copies of all relevant mark sheets, certificates, degrees from class Xth to postgraduation, Internship completion Certificate, Valid Registration of Graduation, Post graduation from NMC, other testimonial (s), Experience Certificate & No Objection Certificate (if employed), with the application form.

Submit the application form complete in all respects, super-scribing on the top-left side of the cover, the post applied for, advertisement number and its date, to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 on or before 2 November 2026 (04:00 p.m.).
important_instructions: Hard copies of the application form will not be received after 02.11.2026 (04:00 p.m.), and the University is not responsible for postal delays. Separate application forms must be filled for each post detailed under a different serial number. A non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- is to be paid online through the Careers Portal, except for PwD candidates who upload an authentic Disability Certificate. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification at the time of the interview, failing which they will not be allowed to appear. No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued to candidates; they must report to the office of the Dean as per the official schedule. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Incomplete applications or applications on plain paper will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 2 vacancies distributed across two departments in the Faculty of Medicine.

rows.qualification: As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Senior Resident positions will receive remuneration at Pay Level AL-11. The appointments are made on a purely temporary basis and are subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason. Candidates are required to report to the office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh half an hour before the scheduled time of the Local Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: High School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and Degree of Post-Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M. Phil/Ph.D. Degree wherever applicable Experience Certificates wherever applicable Internship completion Certificate Valid Registration of Graduation and Post graduation from NMC No Objection Certificate (if employed from present employer/relieving orders of all previous employers) Other testimonial(s)

content_sections.heading: AMU Senior Resident Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Hard copies of the application form will not be received after 02.11.2026 (04:00 p.m.), and the University is not responsible for postal delays. Separate application forms must be filled for each post detailed under a different serial number. A non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- is to be paid online through the Careers Portal, except for PwD candidates who upload an authentic Disability Certificate. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification at the time of the interview, failing which they will not be allowed to appear. No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued to candidates; they must report to the office of the Dean as per the official schedule. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Incomplete applications or applications on plain paper will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in AMU Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Senior Resident posts under advertisement number FM/39/2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which departments have vacancies announced in this notification?
faq.answer: Vacancies are announced for the Department of Microbiology (1 post) and the Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery (1 post).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the hard copy of the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the hard copy of the online filled application form is 2 November 2026 up to 04:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AMU Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs. 500/-, which is to be paid online. PwD candidates are exempt from the fee upon uploading an authentic Disability Certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per NMC norms and the Residency Scheme adopted by AMU.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a pay level of AL-11.

faq.question: Q7. When and where will the selection interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee interview will be held on 11 November 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, as per the scheduled time for each department.

faq.question: Q8. Will a separate interview letter be issued to shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: No separate notice or interview letter will be issued to candidates; applicants must report directly based on the published schedule.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointments are made on a purely temporary basis subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The printed application form along with attachments must be sent to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002.
